Why post oak?

It's the hardwood Central Texas is known for. Dense, slow burning, great coals and few sparks. It's also what Texas BBQ is built on.

  • Fireplace · hot, long burns on cold nights
  • Fire pit · a bundle lasts 2 to 3 nights
